messages:
emma: Quick ping  quarterly least-priv sweep kickoff. I ran the entitlement delta for KMS keys and we have ~140 principals with 'decrypt' grants in prod. Proposing a small canary prune: 6 grants across 3 services in us-east1. owners get a 5-business-day justification window before revoke.

raj: Sounds good. can we scope to services whose failure is non-customer-facing? we should avoid payment/crypto paths.

lucas: I can help classify by service tag and last-used. FYI ~60% of those principals show zero decrypt events in the last 120 days.

tara: +1 to canary. prefer rolling revokes with a guard: TTL label + automated health-check that watches decrypt-fail counters. If failures spike, rollback automatically.

emma: plan: 1) generate owner ping bundle 2) after TTL, create revoke PR with a max concurrency of 3 revokes 3) PR triggers rollout job that annotates change with audit-id and ticket id 4) observe 48h.

lucas: owner discovery snippet I used:```sh
# list keys and bindings (example)
gcloud kms keys list --location=us-east1 --keyring=prod-keys --format=json | jq '.[] | {name: .name, bindings: .acl}'
```

raj: good. also verify HR mapping for owner emails; access-bot flagged ~40 principals with missing owners. we should attach "unknown-owner" tags and treat those higher-risk for immediate manual review.

tara: for rollback: steps are re-grant IAM binding, restart service replica, and clear local decrypt caches. automation: runbook will call an internal endpoint to re-seed keys and kick-worker. keep a 90-minute manual window to allow human abort.

emma: I'll draft the owner ping template. short & explicit: "You have X KMS grants. Please confirm necessity or request renewal by <date>. No response -> revoke planned." include a link to the justification form.

lucas: for telemetry gating: watch three metrics - decrypt_errors/sec, decrypt_p50_latency, job-failures-with-crypto. alert if decrypt_errors increases by >0.5% absolute or if failures >5 events in 10m.

access-bot: New access snapshot: https://audit.internal/report/3650001234 (gz 58MB). Summary: 142 grants, 42 principals w/ no owner mapping, 85 principals last-used >90d. Recommended: canary 6 -> 48h monitor.

raj: who will create the revoke PR? we should include a changelog entry and the exact audit id in PR title. also require two approvers (security + service owner) before merge.

emma: I'll create the PR template and ownership checklist. rgds CI: require a gated rollout job that enforces concurrency and telemetry check.

tara: I'll implement rollback script and add a small chaos-check locally to validate re-grant path. also recommend adding a short post-action runbook to capture owner evidence and time-to-rollback if triggered.

emma: timeline: owner pings today, review responses through EOD next Wed, create canary PR Thu, observe Fri-Mon. notify support and oncall channel prior to merge.

lucas: leaving a note: avoid touching keys used by our PCI subsystem and tokenization service. I flagged the token svc in the export.

emma: ok. next steps - lucas to produce CSV with owner contact + last-use, raj to reconcile HR mapping for missing owners, tara to author rollback and telemetry checks, I'll draft pings and PR template. tagging owners-bot to run pings at 2026-04-02T15:00Z.

access-bot: Scheduled: owner pings to be sent 2026-04-02T15:00Z.

emma: thanks all. small careful steps. we'll iterate after the canary. :thumbsup:
